lines.en: Once upon a time, a girl named Cinderella swept the [cinders] all day long.
lines.zh: 从前，有个叫灰姑娘的女孩，整天都在打扫炉灰。

lines.en: Her [stepmother] dumped the [laundry] on her, then left for the royal [ball].
lines.zh: 继母把一大堆脏衣服丢给她，就去参加王宫舞会了。

lines.en: Poof! Her [fairy godmother] appeared. But her magic [wand] turned the broom into a chicken!
lines.zh: “噗”的一声，仙女教母出现了。可她的魔杖一挥，扫帚竟变成了一只鸡！

lines.en: Let's try again! The [pumpkin] became a golden [carriage], and her rags became a lovely [gown].
lines.zh: 再来一次！南瓜变成了金色马车，破衣裳变成了漂亮的礼服。

lines.en: At the ball, the prince was [speechless]. They danced and danced, and the sisters were [furious].
lines.zh: 舞会上，王子看得说不出话来。他们跳了一支又一支舞，姐姐们气坏了。

lines.en: But at [midnight], the clock struck twelve. She ran away and lost a glass [slipper].
lines.zh: 可是到了午夜，钟声敲响十二下。她慌忙跑开，掉了一只玻璃鞋。

lines.en: The prince searched every house. A stepsister tried to [squeeze] her foot in. No luck!
lines.zh: 王子挨家挨户地找。一个姐姐拼命把脚往鞋里塞，可就是穿不进去！

lines.en: Then Cinderella tried it on. It was a [perfect fit]! The end.
lines.zh: 灰姑娘一试，正好合脚！故事讲完啦。
